title: A New South Asian Arts Festival Comes To London
summary: London will have a new South Asian arts festival. The nine-day event will take place in South Kensington’s cultural quarter next summer, featuring artists from India and its diaspora. title: Florida Heat Melts Metal Statue of Ron DeSantis
summary: A life-size metal statue of Florida governor Ron DeSantis was unveiled in the state capital of Tallahassee last week and immediately began to melt, The Guardian reports, revealing a skull behind the politician’s face. The project was organized by environmental activists seeking to highlight the Republican leader’s sustained efforts to end or block climate-change protections. […]

summary: Visitors attending the inaugural VIP preview day of the 2026 edition of Art Basel Paris yesterday were forced to wend their way through concrete anti-ram barriers encircling the landmark Grand Palais where the event is hosted, the New York Times reports. title: Protest Draws Hundreds In Support Of A Colombian Museum
summary: The far-right government in Colombia removed more than 30 works from the permanent displays of the Museo Nacional de Colombia in Bogotá, citing “political indoctrination.” The works removed included dozens of objects related to LGBTQ rights and feminism. title: FOG Design+Art Names Exhibitors for 2027 Fair
summary: The FOG Design+Art fair has announced seventy-six exhibitors for its 2027 edition, which runs January 21–24 at the Fort Mason Center for the Arts in San Francisco. title: Chinese Terracotta Army Built by Women and Children, Not Only Men
summary: The study of seventy-nine fingerprints visible in the clay used to form some of the terracotta warriors in Xi’an, China, has revealed that the makers of the statues included not just adult men but also women and children. The research was published in the Journal of Cultural Heritage and reported in the magazine Archaeology News. […]

title: Emer Grant Appointed Inaugural Creative Director of Liverpool’s Bluecoat
summary: Liverpool’s Bluecoat has named Emer Grant as its new creative director. Grant is the first person named to the position at the museum since its founding in 1927. title: Hélia Paukner Named Artistic Director of Biennale de Lyon
summary: The Biennale de Lyon has announced Hélia Paukner as its new artistic director, effective February 1, 2027. Pauker will also take over the directorship of the Musée d’Art Contemporain de Lyon (macLYON), her appointment maintaining the long-standing partnership between the Biennale and the museum. She succeeds Isabelle Bertolotti, who has occupied both roles since 2019. […]

summary: Master’s students at the Design Academy Eindhoven (DAE) staged protests during the school’s graduation exhibition to demand action against overcrowded facilities.
